svg.title: MATH-07 sequence limits, completeness, uniformity, and binary64 audit
svg.desc: Four scientific panels show geometric epsilon-N thresholds, exact rational Newton iterates approaching square root two, pointwise but nonuniform convergence of x to the n, and binary64 rounding of one plus two to the minus n.
svg.text: MATH-07 audit · tail witnesses, missing limits, moving hard points, and finite precision
Finite computation diagnoses a proof contract; it does not replace the universal epsilon–N, completeness, or uniform-convergence theorem.
limit in R = sqrt(2), but sqrt(2) is not in Q
C · Pointwise x^n and moving input
true sup error = 1 for every n; moving witness has error 1/2
blue: exact -log2(error); orange: binary64 until error becomes zero
